proposition.claim:
Judgment: Minor, for the classical pointwise reading. Lemma 3.3, PDF page 17, equation (3.9), asserts for \(\omega\in C^1_0(\mathbb R)\) and its bounded harmonic extension to the upper half-plane that \[\partial_yu(x+i0)=H[-\omega'].\] The TeX label is `lem:normal_derivative_harmonic_extension`. The proof ends by passing through the Hilbert transform from \(C^1\) convergence of the boundary approximations. Such convergence does not imply finite pointwise convergence of the Hilbert transforms of their continuous derivatives.

Explicit cutoff is C1 with matching endpoint derivatives; omega and omega' tend to 0 at the origin; compact support; bounded real-valued Poisson extension. Negating also meets a nonpositive-weight convention.
